thread:
sara: starting three-wave rollout for release v2.7.1 — plan is US (slice A) -> EU (slice B) -> APAC (slice C). slices: 10% / 30% / 60%. deploybot will announce each step. holdpoints at completion of each slice. ping if anything looks off. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: release=v2.7.1 targets=[us-west-2] slice=10% rollout_id=rl-20240318-71

mike: quick check — are routing pins already set to v2.7.1-20240318 in the config service? i want to avoid split-brain when we flip traffic.

sara: yes mike, pin is set in routing-config service under key /prod/model/current -> v2.7.1-20240318. I pushed the DB migration earlier.

chris-sre: running pre-roll capacity sweep now. preliminary numbers: us-west-2 GPU util ~72% baseline, headroom ~28%. warm pool capacity available: 4 instances. if slice cold-starts spike, we have a +2 replica cushion. alarms at 90% util.

oncall-sre: FYI we've updated prom thresholds for p95 and 5xx during the window. p95 alert = 300ms, 5xx-rate alert = 0.5% sustained 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed for us-west-2 canary instance(s). logs: 
```
2024-03-18T14:07:02Z canary-start
healthcheck: ok
avg-latency: 120ms
error-rate: 0.02%
```

alice: seeing a small bump in tail latency on the canary under synthetic load: p99 -> 420ms for a 30s blip. not sustained. recommending keep the wave but watch p99 for next 3m.

chris-sre: agreed. holdpoint: do not proceed to EU slice until p99 stays < 350ms for 3 consecutive minutes and 5xx < 0.2%. if flaps, we'll either scale warm pool or rollback.

sara: acknowledging holdpoint. continuing manual watch. ops-lead if we need to scale, do we have permission to bump warm pool replicas now?

ops-lead: yes, go ahead if alerts trigger. target scale command: 
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=12
```

deploy-bot: mid-roll report: slice A (US) at 10% completed; observed p95=180ms, p99=320ms (down from 420), 5xx=0.03%. no abort triggers so far.

mike: re-confirming rollback triggers: what's the team agreement? I suggest: rollback if 5xx >= 0.5% for >5m OR p95 > 350ms for >5m, or if error budget burn exceeds 30% in 15m.

chris-sre: that's fine. i'll own automated rollback signal if metrics cross thresholds. if we hit p95 > 400ms for 3 min we'll pause and scale first, then consider rollback.

oncall-sre: also add circuit-breaker guard: if a single AZ shows disproportionate errors (>1.5x cluster avg), we will route traffic away from that AZ and continue.

sara: proceeding to EU slice in 5m assuming US holds. calling EU handoff in 5.

deploy-bot: starting slice B -> eu-central-1, slice target=30%. warmup jobs queued. rollout id rl-20240318-71-B

alice: heads-up: eu cluster has slightly higher baseline p95 (220ms). recommend ramp slower there (15% -> 30%) for first 5m.

ops-lead: agreed. adjusting slice parameters: eu ramp initial 15% for 5m then to 30% if healthy.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 15% complete. health: p95=210ms, p99=380ms, 5xx=0.05%. scaling holdpoint in place.

mike: if p99 stays >350ms for EU after full 30% ramp, i'd rather throttle the EU traffic slice and push more to US for now. keep rollback as last resort.

chris-sre: agreed. also note APAC capacity check: ap-southeast-1 has limited spare GPUs today (headroom ~10%). we should be conservative for slice C.

sara: marking APAC as high risk. plan: only proceed to APAC after EU steady for 20m and no alarms. if APAC can't take quant, we will use model-quantized fallback (v2.7.1-q8) which is compatible and cost/lower-latency.

oncall-sre: fallback switch ready. toggle command: `/ops roll-fallback --region ap-southeast-1 --model v2.7.1-q8` (requires ops-lead ack).

ops-lead: acked. we'll only flip fallback if alarms > threshold or thermal events.

sara: final notes: release notes updated: changelog link https://internal/doc/releases/v2.7.1, rollback checklist filed under runbook/rollbacks/v2.7.1. I'll post a summary in #release-notes when APAC ramp completes.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: US=10% EU=30% APAC=60% (APAC routed to fallback q8 due to headroom constraints). Status: SUCCESS. metrics snapshot: p95 global=190ms p99 global=340ms 5xx global=0.06%.

mike: thanks all — no post-deploy regressions seen in first 30m. closing thread unless anyone sees late issues. :tada:
